Markets.title: Silver loses more than half its value from record high: What went wrong and will it recover?
Markets.summary: Silver prices have plummeted more than 58% from a February record high of nearly $120 an ounce to around $50. This sharp decline is driven by profit-booking, weaker industrial demand, and shifting macroeconomic conditions.

Markets.title: Turnaround Story: 8 stocks shift from loss to profit in September '26 quarter
Markets.summary: Eight Nifty 500 stocks, including IndusInd Bank, Tata Motors, and Delhivery, shifted from net losses to profits in the September 2026 quarter. This turnaround was identified through a profitability scan conducted by StockEdge.

Markets.title: Sebi pushes for resilient capital markets, focuses on investor protection: Chairman
Markets.summary: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey emphasized accessible and efficient capital markets while highlighting significant growth in fundraising and market capitalization. He also noted a dramatic increase in investor participation from West Bengal alongside new measures to streamline the system.

Markets.title: Concurrent Gainers: 8 stocks that gain for 5 days in a row
Markets.summary: Between October 26 and 30, eight BSE 500 stocks posted gains in five consecutive trading sessions. These stocks delivered cumulative returns ranging from 10% to 21% during this period.

Markets.title: ET Wealth Expo: Why market veteran S Naren thinks investors are getting gold, silver and asset allocation all wrong
Markets.summary: Market veteran S Naren warns investors against chasing assets like silver after massive price surges lead to heavy corrections. He advises that true asset allocation requires buying unpopular investments while maintaining a steady allocation to gold.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: Big break above 23,200 can open doors for 23,500 for Nifty; Sudeep Shah picks 6 stocks ahead of Diwali
Markets.summary: Analyst Sudeep Shah of SBI Securities states that a decisive break above the 23,150–23,200 resistance zone could push the Nifty toward 23,500. Ahead of Diwali, he shares his market outlook and recommends six stocks, including TVS Motor, Coforge, and ICICI Bank.

Geo-Political.title: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
Geo-Political.summary: The United States has approved the sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine. These American-made interceptors are currently the only effective weapons capable of shooting down Russian ballistic missiles.

Geo-Political.title: Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea
Geo-Political.summary: Crypto exchange Binance is attempting to recover $6.3 billion stolen in what is believed to be the largest cyber-attack of its kind. The complex hack is linked to North Korea.

Geo-Political.summary: Polish police were deployed during a stand-off regarding control of the country's top court. This escalation followed the government's suspension of two senior justices and its move to bring criminal charges against them.

Geo-Political.title: Spain train disaster clouds Sánchez chances of re-election
Geo-Political.summary: A major train disaster has occurred in Spain just weeks before a snap general election. This incident is the latest in a series of crises that are threatening Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's chances of re-election.

Geo-Political.title: G20 'family photo' cancelled after protests over presence of Russian minister
Geo-Political.summary: The G20 canceled its official "family photo" after several nations protested the attendance of the Russian foreign minister. During the meeting, UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband confronted his Russian counterpart, accusing Moscow of killing innocent civilians in Ukraine.

Data & Insights.title: Govt sets up high-level banking panel under Suresh N. Patel
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has established a high-level banking panel led by Suresh N. Patel. The committee will recommend structural and regulatory reforms to make the nation's banking sector globally competitive, inclusive, and resilient by 2047.

Data & Insights.title: Extreme poverty in India falls to 2.6% from 27.1%: World Bank
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2011 and 2023, extreme poverty in India dropped significantly from 27.1% to 2.6%. According to the World Bank, this economic shift lifted 496 million people above the lower-middle-income poverty line of $4.20 a day.

Data & Insights.title: ‘2026 resembles 1991’: Why CEA V Anantha Nageswaran wants India to rethink its growth strategy — what he said
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran warned that global tensions and supply-chain shocks threaten India's access to critical resources. He urged the country to strengthen domestic capabilities, diversify imports, and build strategic buffers.

Data & Insights.title: West Asia conflict drives 15-20% surge in working capital demand at Indian banks, lifts corporate credit growth: Report
Data & Insights.summary: The West Asia conflict caused a 15% to 20% increase in working capital demand at Indian banks due to higher raw material costs and shipping delays. This surge, along with refinancing and acquisition borrowing, helped drive corporate credit growth during the September quarter.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | What does the proposed India-Mexico preferential trade agreement mean for Indian exporters?
Data & Insights.summary: A proposed Preferential Trade Agreement between India and Mexico could help Indian exporters secure negotiated tariff concessions. These concessions would improve the price competitiveness of Indian goods in the Mexican market.

India.title: 5-Year-Old Indian-Origin Math Prodigy Honoured At Canada's Ontario Legislative Assembly
India.summary: Five-year-old Indian-origin math prodigy Arjun was honored at Canada's Ontario Legislative Assembly. He achieved a Full Scale IQ score of 141, placing him in the 99.7th percentile.

India.title: Goa Cop Sexually Assaults Minor Girl Multiple Times At Crime Branch Office
India.summary: A Goa police officer and a female accomplice sexually assaulted a minor girl multiple times. The assaults took place at the Crime Branch office in Ribandar on July 25 and October 27.

India.title: Class Underway, Man Enters Andhra School With Chainsaw, Attacks 2 Girls
India.summary: A man entered a school in Andhra Pradesh with a chainsaw while classes were underway and attacked two girls. Police have launched an investigation to trace the attacker and determine the motive behind the incident.

India.title: Hyderabad Delivery Agent Falls Into Flooded Drain While Riding, Then A Rescue
India.summary: A Hyderabad delivery executive named Ghantasala Arjun Kumar fell into an open drain while riding his motorcycle during heavy rains. He was subsequently rescued.

India.title: Hotel, Cruise: PM Modi's Rs 426 Crore Tourism Boost For Statue Of Unity In Gujarat
India.summary: Prime Minister Modi has announced a Rs 426 crore tourism development project for the Statue of Unity in Gujarat, which includes new hotel and cruise facilities. Additionally, the initiative features a planned disaster control room to enhance safety and emergency response at the nearby Sardar Sarovar Dam.

India.title: Two Foreigners Die Of Electrocution At Bengaluru 5-Star Hotel Swimming Pool
India.summary: Two foreign nationals died of electrocution in the swimming pool of a five-star hotel in Bengaluru. Another foreign national sustained injuries in the same incident.
